Instructions: Use this semantic model to answer questions about investment clients, their accounts, the securities they hold, and daily position valuations. FACT_POSITION is the daily grain fact table; DIM_ACCOUNT, DIM_CLIENT, DIM_SECURITY, and DIM_DATE provide descriptive context.
Synonyms: portfolio model, wealth management model, investment book of record
Examples: What is the total market value by account as of the latest date?; Show the top 10 holdings by market value for a given client; How has unrealized gain/loss trended over the last quarter?

Instructions: Daily snapshot of security holdings per account. One row per account/security/date combination captures the quantity held and its valuation as of that date.
Synonyms: holdings, positions, portfolio snapshot, book of record
Examples: Total market value by account; positions with the largest unrealized loss today

Instructions: Primary measure of position value; equals QUANTITY multiplied by MARKET_PRICE, in LOCAL_CURRENCY.
Synonyms: position value, holding value, market val

Instructions: Computed as MARKET_VALUE minus COST_BASIS. Positive values indicate an unrealized gain, negative values indicate an unrealized loss.
Synonyms: unrealized P&L, paper gain, paper loss

Instructions: Number of shares/units of the security held in the account as of the snapshot date.
Synonyms: units held, shares held, position size

Instructions: One row per investment account owned by a client. Slowly changing dimension tracked via OPEN_DATE/CLOSE_DATE and ACCOUNT_STATUS.
The account wrapper/tax treatment, e.g. Brokerage, IRA, 401k, or Trust.
Synonyms: account category, wrapper type, plan type

Instructions: Customer-facing account number. Treat as sensitive; avoid exposing in shared reports.
One row per client or household relationship that owns one or more accounts.
Legal name of the client. Contains PII; mask or omit in externally shared results.
Synonyms: client name, customer name, household name

Instructions: Client's stated risk tolerance, used to evaluate portfolio suitability.
One row per tradable security or instrument that can appear in a position.
Synonyms: instruments, holdings reference, products, securities master

Instructions: Broad instrument category, e.g. Equity, Bond, ETF, Mutual Fund, or Cash.
Synonyms: asset type, instrument type, product type

Instructions: Standard calendar date dimension used to slice and trend positions by day, month, quarter, or year.
